title: Zoom in: one truck's route for a time range, read at LOCAL_QUORUM
caption: The day bucket turns a time range into one partition; two replicas answer, but only one sends the rows.

messages.label: bucket = (4417, today)
messages.note: The range is inside one day, so it is one partition: a single seek, then a contiguous slice in timestamp order.

messages.label: read rows
messages.note: The closest replica, by the snitch's latency scores, sends the data.

messages.label: digest read
messages.note: The other replica sends only a hash of its answer.

messages.label: digest
messages.note: The hashes match: both replicas agree.

scenarios.name: Range spans midnight
scenarios.summary: A night shift crosses two day buckets: two partition reads in parallel, merged by timestamp.

messages.label: buckets = yesterday, today
messages.note: The service computes the buckets from the range; the database never scans to find them.

messages.label: SELECT (4417, today) …
messages.note: Sent in parallel, not as one IN query, so each goes to its own replica set.

messages.label: merged route
messages.note: A month-long range would be 30 partitions: cap the range or send it to analytics.

scenarios.name: Replicas disagree
scenarios.summary: A missed a few writes, so the digest doesn't match. The coordinator merges by write timestamp, answers, and repairs the stale replica.

messages.label: digest ≠
messages.note: A was restarting when the last readings were written and their hints haven't been replayed yet.

messages.label: full read
messages.note: Now both replicas send their rows.

messages.label: merge, newest write wins
messages.note: Each cell carries a write timestamp; the merged result has every reading either replica holds.

messages.label: read repair: missing rows
messages.note: Blocking read repair: the answer waits until A has the merged rows, so a second quorum read can't see less.

scenarios.name: Replica A stalls
scenarios.summary: The data replica is slow; speculative retry reads another replica instead of waiting for a timeout.

messages.label: read rows
messages.note: A is in a long GC pause and doesn't answer.

messages.label: speculative: own copy
messages.note: B is the third replica of this partition. After the usual 99th-percentile wait it reads its own copy instead of waiting for A's timeout.

messages.label: own rows match C's digest
messages.note: B and C make the quorum without A.
